title: C2c R8 + v7 own-issued clock closed loop (deadband 2, no retraining, GPU)
registration_order: Committed before any C2c GPU evaluation. At commit time no C2c eval output existed. Only the specification/report documents, the finished C2a/C2b CPU results, the read-only R8 checkpoint hash, and the C2c code/tests were inspected.
approval: 창민 2026-10-19 C2c 승인: 2.9 VM-h, 새 run root, 새 branch. R3 재학습은 no-go 유지.
label: engineering-only / sim / HO4 diagnostic / not a promotion gate / pooling 금지

spec.opening_condition: C2a INCONCLUSIVE + C2b done path PASS + 창민 approval; all three are satisfied.

change.only: Evaluation-side own-issued PWM clock (pwm_elapsed_s) definition. No contract file, adapter, weight, dataset or label change.
change.v6: reset the pwm clock whenever the last issued PWM differs from the previous tick (any change).
change.v7: reset the pwm clock only when one servo moves by at least 3 PWM from the previously observed issued value, i.e. a ±2 deadband is ignored (the flag names the tolerated band; the reset threshold is 3, equal to C2b S2/S3/S4).
change.hook: scripts/act18_evaluate.py patches harness.grasp_act_contract.IssuedClock for the evaluation process (contract file itself unchanged, sha checked) and re-applies the same clock to the allowed observation received from the physics owner before Actor.predict, because the owner builds observations in a separate process. skill_elapsed_s and every other observation field are unchanged.
change.diag_stage: --stage diag --diag-prereg <this file> admits only the HO4 seeds below; overlapping TRAIN4/VAL8/FINAL40 fails closed; summary records stage=diag, gate_eligible=false and the prereg SHA.
change.no_retraining: R3 training is no-go. R8 step-100000 is read-only; its sha256 is recorded before and after every run.

holdout.name: HO4
holdout.rule: HO4 seeds are not TRAIN4, VAL8 or FINAL40, and are not used for best-val selection or DAgger in any R run. The diag path fails closed if any registered seed overlaps a locked gate set.

TRAIN4.grouping_note: Same two-world grouping as the finish-r3/repro TRAIN4 baseline; the four seeds cannot be paired arbitrarily because the compiled reference is shared per group.

evaluator.seed: 2 robots per group (r1 student, r2 partner/solo teacher-controlled according to the frozen owner), dataset/eval seed set as listed; no new seed

metrics.G: grasp_done requested AND a 3 s stable lift (clearance >= .012 m, tilt <= 10 deg, each finger >= .5 N, weld off) completed at or before the grasp done tick.
metrics.Pre: a grasp done was requested but no 3 s stable lift had completed at that tick (early or ungraded done).
metrics.done_claim: issued grasp done tick (the ACT done claim); release_done_claim likewise for release.
metrics.first_done_prob_ge_065: first chunk-level raw done probability >= .65 tick and its pwm_elapsed_s (recorded with --record-done-prob; reporting only).
metrics.post_lift_max_pe: maximum pwm_elapsed_s after the first 3 s stable lift onset (evaluation-only truth for timing).
metrics.T: task_success from the native score (report only, no gate).

acceptance.PASS: G(C2c-HO4) >= 4 AND G(C2c-TRAIN4) >= 4 AND Pre(C2c total 24) <= 2 AND G(B0-HO4) <= 1.
acceptance.FAIL: G(C2c-HO4) <= 1 AND G(C2c-TRAIN4) <= 1, OR Pre(C2c total 24) >= 5.
acceptance.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else; no training seed exists so an N increase requires approval.
acceptance.T: reported only; §8 milestone T(C2c-HO4) >= 1 is reported separately.
acceptance.fisher_note: PASS reference: Fisher one-sided 4/12 vs 0/12 p = 0.047.
acceptance.no_result_based_changes: No threshold, seed, arm or metric definition may change after results are seen.

pooling.statement: Do not pool with finish-r3, 20261019/20261019c, act-chunk8-pilot, E0/E1, VAL8, FINAL40, act17 or act16w. B0-TRAIN4 is a new run in this root; existing finish-r3 reproductions are shown only as context and are never summed.
pooling.HO4: HO4 is a diagnostic holdout outside the promotion gate; no gate-eligible claim.

r3.note: This prereg authorizes evaluation only; no C2c result can open R3 training.

safety.stop: processes 0 and GPU 0 after runs, lease removed, TERMINATED confirmed; no VM restart loop, only start retries after STOCKOUT.

analysis.raw_locations: each run's evaluation/summary.json, rejection_table.json, actor-inputs.jsonl, done-prob jsonl, owner/evaluation-only.jsonl
